Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: unimplemented.

The backend’s digest check protects admission/run reads, but that is not a focus-triggered UI refresh. The inspected desktop shell evidence did not show a focus listener that rechecks sources/assets and refreshes source cards, design preview, and run state after external changes. Keep this as a separate responsiveness ticket: wire non-blocking focus activation to source verification, handle stale completions, and test changed/missing/restored transitions.

Evidence:
- studio/core/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/real/RealStudyBackend.scala:107
- studio/desktop/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/StudioWindow.scala:60

Remaining / next action: Implement focus-triggered source/asset verification and its state-transition tests.

Disposition: Keep open.
